descriptions.text: Isoamyl acetate is the acetate ester of isoamylol. It has a role as a metabolite and a Saccharomyces cerevisiae metabolite. It is functionally related to an isoamylol.

en.title: Isoamyl acetate
en.extract: Isoamyl acetate, also known as isopentyl acetate, is an ester formed from isoamyl alcohol and acetic acid, with the molecular formula C7H14O2. It is a colorless liquid that is only slightly soluble in water, but very soluble in most organic solvents. Isoamyl acetate has a strong odor which is described as similar to both banana and pear. Pure isoamyl acetate, or mixtures of isoamyl acetate, amyl acetate, and other flavors in ethanol may be referred to as banana oil or pear oil.
